interfaces.name: Entry
interfaces.signature: @Model final class Entry { var id: UUID; var title: String; var createdAt: Date; var updatedAt: Date; var audioRelativePath: String; var durationSeconds: TimeInterval; var recordingStatus: RecordingPersistedStatus; var transcriptionStatus: TranscriptionStatus; var cachedTranscriptText: String; var moodScore: Double?; var moodLabel: String?; var moodStatus: SuggestionStatus; var waveformSummary: [Float]; var isDemo: Bool; @Relationship(deleteRule: .cascade, inverse: \Anchor.entry) var anchors: [Anchor]; @Relationship(deleteRule: .cascade, inverse: \Tag.entry) var tags: [Tag]; @Relationship(deleteRule: .cascade, inverse: \Sketch.entry) var sketches: [Sketch]; @Relationship(deleteRule: .cascade, inverse: \Mention.sourceEntry) var outgoingMentions: [Mention] }
interfaces.notes: Single source of truth; every field is read live via @Query, never cached in a view model.

interfaces.name: RecordingPersistedStatus
interfaces.signature: enum RecordingPersistedStatus: String, Codable { case finalized, interrupted, recoveredAfterUnexpectedExit }
interfaces.notes: Coarse disk-truth status stored on Entry; distinct from the richer in-memory RecordingState used live by RecordingController.

interfaces.name: TranscriptionStatus
interfaces.signature: enum TranscriptionStatus: String, Codable { case notStarted, modelDownloading, transcribing, ready, unavailable }
interfaces.notes: Three-plus-state model per DEC-detailed_discussion-002; drives Timeline badge and Entry Detail copy.

interfaces.name: SuggestionStatus
interfaces.signature: enum SuggestionStatus: String, Codable { case suggested, accepted, dismissed, userAdded }
interfaces.notes: Shared by Tag and Entry.moodStatus so accept/dismiss UI is one code path.

interfaces.name: Anchor
interfaces.signature: @Model final class Anchor { var id: UUID; var entry: Entry?; var startTime: TimeInterval; var endTime: TimeInterval; var sequenceIndex: Int; var text: String; var isDeleted: Bool }
interfaces.notes: id/startTime/endTime/sequenceIndex are immutable once created; text and isDeleted are the only mutable overlay fields (DEC-prompt_contract-015).

interfaces.name: Tag
interfaces.signature: @Model final class Tag { var id: UUID; var entry: Entry?; var name: String; var source: TagSource; var status: SuggestionStatus }

interfaces.name: TagSource
interfaces.signature: enum TagSource: String, Codable { case aiSuggested, userAdded }

interfaces.name: Mention
interfaces.signature: @Model final class Mention { var id: UUID; var sourceEntry: Entry?; var targetEntryID: UUID; var anchorID: UUID?; var createdAt: Date }
interfaces.notes: targetEntryID is a raw UUID, not a SwiftData relationship, so a deleted target is detectable (broken link) instead of silently cascading.

interfaces.name: Sketch
interfaces.signature: @Model final class Sketch { var id: UUID; var entry: Entry?; @Attribute(.externalStorage) var drawingData: Data; var createdAt: Date }

interfaces.name: ModelContainerFactory
interfaces.signature: enum ModelContainerFactory { static func make(cloudKitEnabled: Bool) throws -> ModelContainer }
interfaces.notes: Single construction point used identically by app, widget, Share Extension, and CarPlay code path; App Group container id lives in AppGroupConfig.

interfaces.name: AppGroupConfig
interfaces.signature: enum AppGroupConfig { static let identifier: String; static var containerURL: URL { get } }

interfaces.name: FileProtectionHelper
interfaces.signature: enum FileProtectionHelper { static func applyCompleteUntilFirstAuth(to url: URL) throws }

interfaces.name: SearchRelevanceScorer
interfaces.signature: enum SearchRelevanceScorer { static func score(entry: Entry, queryTokens: [String], now: Date) -> SearchScoreResult; static func search(query: String, in entries: [Entry], now: Date) -> [SearchScoreResult] }
interfaces.notes: Deterministic, pure, documented formula (transcript 3pt/word +5 phrase, tag 5pt exact, mood 4pt, recency up to 2pt gated on nonzero content match). Sorted desc, zero-score entries excluded.

interfaces.name: SearchScoreResult
interfaces.signature: struct SearchScoreResult: Identifiable, Sendable { let id: UUID; let entryID: UUID; let total: Double; let transcriptScore: Double; let tagScore: Double; let moodScore: Double; let recencyBonus: Double; let matchReasons: [MatchReason] }

interfaces.name: MatchReason
interfaces.signature: enum MatchReason: String, Codable { case transcript, tag, mood }
interfaces.notes: Feeds the SearchResultRow match-reason hint.

interfaces.name: BacklinkQuery
interfaces.signature: enum BacklinkQuery { static func backlinks(for entryID: UUID, in context: ModelContext) -> [Entry]; static func isBroken(_ mention: Mention, in context: ModelContext) -> Bool; static func resolveSeekTarget(tappedAnchorID: UUID, in anchors: [Anchor]) -> TimeInterval }
interfaces.notes: backlinks() dedupes by sourceEntry.id; resolveSeekTarget implements the nearest-surviving-anchor fallback (DEC-detailed_discussion-004).

interfaces.name: MentionAutocompleteQuery
interfaces.signature: enum MentionAutocompleteQuery { static func candidates(matching text: String, excluding currentEntryID: UUID, demoScope: Bool, in context: ModelContext) -> [Entry] }
interfaces.notes: Filters by isDemo == demoScope and excludes self, enforcing DEC-detailed_discussion-009 and self-mention rejection.

interfaces.name: DemoDataSeeder
interfaces.signature: enum DemoDataSeeder { static func seed(in context: ModelContext) throws; static func removeAll(in context: ModelContext) throws }
interfaces.notes: Must guarantee one HealthKit-correlated day and one broken-link example; idempotent on repeat seed calls.

interfaces.name: Theme
interfaces.signature: enum Theme { enum Color { static let background, surface, textPrimary, textSecondary, accent, border, moodPositive, moodNeutral, moodNegative: SwiftUI.Color }; enum Spacing { static let xs=4.0, sm=8.0, md=12.0, lg=16.0, xl=24.0, xxl=32.0, xxxl=48.0 }; enum Radius { static let small=8.0, medium=14.0, large=20.0, full=999.0 }; enum Font { static let display, title, headline, body, callout, caption, micro: SwiftUI.Font } }
interfaces.notes: Every view references this; no scattered literals.

interfaces.name: RecordingState
interfaces.signature: enum RecordingState: Equatable { case idle, arming, recording, interrupted(resumable: Bool), finalizing, finalized, error(RecordingError) }
interfaces.notes: Transient in-memory state driving RecordButton/InterruptionBanner; distinct from Entry.recordingStatus.

interfaces.name: RecordingController
interfaces.signature: actor RecordingController { func start() async throws; func stop() async; func handleInterruption(type: AVAudioSession.InterruptionType, options: AVAudioSession.InterruptionOptions) async; func handleRouteChange(reason: AVAudioSession.RouteChangeReason) async; var state: RecordingState { get async }; var amplitudeStream: AsyncStream<Float> { get } }
interfaces.notes: NotificationCenter observers are a thin adapter forwarding into these two handle methods, per DEC-ios_architecture_review-005, so CI can call them directly.

interfaces.name: RecordingError
interfaces.signature: enum RecordingError: Error, Equatable { case sessionActivationFailed, diskWriteFailed, insufficientStorage }

interfaces.name: RecordingReconciler
interfaces.signature: enum RecordingReconciler { static func reconcileOnLaunch(in context: ModelContext) throws }
interfaces.notes: Scans for entries stuck in .interrupted with no finalize and marks them .recoveredAfterUnexpectedExit from whatever was flushed to disk.

interfaces.name: TranscriptionCoordinator
interfaces.signature: final class TranscriptionCoordinator { func transcribe(entryID: UUID) -> Task<Void, Never>; static func availability(for locale: Locale) -> SpeechAvailabilityState }
interfaces.notes: One Task per entry, never a shared serializing actor (DEC-design_handoff-003).

interfaces.name: SpeechAvailabilityState
interfaces.signature: enum SpeechAvailabilityState { case ready, modelDownloading, unavailable }

interfaces.name: AutoTagger
interfaces.signature: enum AutoTagger { static func suggestTags(from text: String) -> [String]; static func moodScore(from text: String) -> Double }
interfaces.notes: NLTagger/NLTagger(.sentimentScore) wrapper; output is always presented as dismissible/acceptable, never auto-applied.

interfaces.name: HealthContextProvider
interfaces.signature: final class HealthContextProvider { func requestAuthorization() async throws; func dailySummary(for date: Date) async -> HealthDaySummary? }
interfaces.notes: Live query only; return value is nil for both denial and genuine no-data, matching DEC-detailed_discussion-006's hedged copy.

interfaces.name: HealthDaySummary
interfaces.signature: struct HealthDaySummary { let date: Date; let sleepHours: Double?; let stepCount: Int? }

interfaces.name: SubscriptionManager
interfaces.signature: final class SubscriptionManager { func purchase(_ product: Product) async throws -> Bool; func isProActive() async -> Bool; func observeTransactions() -> Task<Void, Never> }
interfaces.notes: Entitlement checks always via Transaction.currentEntitlements locally; one network round-trip only at purchase time.

interfaces.name: RecordingActivityAttributes
interfaces.signature: struct RecordingActivityAttributes: ActivityAttributes { struct ContentState: Codable, Hashable { var elapsedSeconds: TimeInterval; var amplitudeSample: Float }; var startedAt: Date }
interfaces.notes: Lives in Core so both the app (starts it) and widget extension (renders it) share the identical type.

interfaces.name: LiveActivityController
interfaces.signature: enum LiveActivityController { static func start(for entryID: UUID) throws; static func update(elapsed: TimeInterval, amplitude: Float); static func end(finalState: RecordingActivityAttributes.ContentState) async }
interfaces.notes: Uses staleDate plus RecordingReconciler-driven relaunch cleanup per the documented residual-window caveat.

interfaces.name: FieldnotesWidgetEntry
interfaces.signature: struct FieldnotesWidgetEntry: TimelineEntry { let date: Date; let latestEntrySnippet: String?; let moodLabel: String? }
interfaces.notes: WidgetCenter.reloadTimelines() called only on confirmed entry save.

interfaces.name: ShareEntryComposer
interfaces.signature: enum ShareEntryComposer { static func makeEntry(from itemProviders: [NSItemProvider], in context: ModelContext) async throws -> UUID }
interfaces.notes: One-way import only (text or photo), never outbound sharing to people.

interfaces.name: CarPlayRecordCoordinator
interfaces.signature: final class CarPlayRecordCoordinator { func templateApplicationScene(_ scene: CPTemplateApplicationScene, didConnect interfaceController: CPInterfaceController) }
interfaces.notes: Compiles and is wired correctly but is a named Gap: requires the CarPlay audio-app entitlement unavailable on a free personal developer account.

interfaces.name: StartVoiceEntryIntent
interfaces.signature: struct StartVoiceEntryIntent: AppIntent { static var title: LocalizedStringResource; func perform() async throws -> some IntentResult }

interfaces.name: SearchJournalIntent
interfaces.signature: struct SearchJournalIntent: AppIntent { @Parameter var query: String; func perform() async throws -> some IntentResult & ReturnsValue<[String]> }
